name: Dana Poly Corp.
old_description: Plastic Bags & Custom Packaging Solutions That Protect and Represent Your Products
about:
Dana Poly Corp. was founded in 1990 in Dover, New Jersey, as a manufacturer of polyethylene film, bags, and sheet products. The company operates from a single New Jersey facility that has been producing plastic packaging in the United States since its inception.

The company’s core operations center on custom extrusion and converting of polyethylene resins into a wide range of products, including bin liners, box liners, drum liners, gaylord liners, pallet covers, furniture and mattress bags, anti-static bags, and construction sheeting. Its facility is strategically positioned adjacent to a dedicated rail stop that feeds resin directly into two large storage silos, and it features multiple loading bays for high-volume trailer shipments. Since 2017, the plant has been partially powered by a solar array, reflecting a stated commitment to reducing its carbon footprint.

Dana Poly serves industries such as packaging, textiles, furniture, construction, and specialized anti-static applications. Its customer base includes buyers of industrial liners, carpet and textile bags, furniture and mattress protection, and bed-bug barrier products, as well as general packaging purchasers seeking custom-printed film and sheeting.

The company emphasizes its HACCP and GMP certifications, an on-site quality control lab that conducts raw-material, in-process, and product-performance testing, and a resin development team that assists with material selection and design. Rail-direct logistics, solar energy, and high-speed printing presses are cited as factors that enable faster turnaround and cost efficiency.
